author: Praxis V
title: Diagnostics: σ_kd distributions — Ridge vs FWPCA-only at δ=0.12 (kd=22, k=50)
abstract: Analysis-only test. Computes kd-th neighbor distance (σ_kd) distributions from final distance graphs for Ridge (GraphFWPCA+BRBG+DAQB) and FWPCA-only, both at δ=0.12 (kd=22, k=50). Reports global and per-batch summaries (median, mean, CV, Gini).

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import scipy.sparse as sp

sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from fwpca_only_utils import run_fwpca_only
import best_adopted_alias as ridge_alias

def _kd_stat_from_distances(D: sp.csr_matrix, kd: int) -> np.ndarray:
    # compute kd-th smallest positive distance per row
    if not sp.isspmatrix_csr(D):
        D = D.tocsr()
    n = D.shape[0]
    sigma = np.full(n, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    idx_ptr = D.indptr
    data = D.data
    for i in range(n):
        start, end = idx_ptr[i], idx_ptr[i+1]
        row = data[start:end]
        if row.size >= kd:
            # partition to get kd-th order statistic (1-based kd -> index kd-1)
            kth = np.partition(row, kd-1)[kd-1]
            sigma[i] = float(kth)
    return sigma

def _gini(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    if x.size == 0:
        return np.nan
    x = np.abs(x)
    if np.allclose(x.sum(), 0):
        return 0.0
    x.sort()
    n = x.size
    cumx = np.cumsum(x)
    return (n + 1 - 2 * np.sum(cumx) / cumx[-1]) / n

def _summaries(sigma: np.ndarray, batches: np.ndarray, label: str):
    mask = np.isfinite(sigma)
    s = sigma[mask]
    out = {
        "label": label,
        "n": int(s.size),
        "median": float(np.median(s)) if s.size else np.nan,
        "mean": float(np.mean(s)) if s.size else np.nan,
        "std": float(np.std(s, ddof=1)) if s.size > 1 else np.nan,
        "cv": float(np.std(s, ddof=1) / np.mean(s)) if s.size > 1 and np.mean(s) > 0 else np.nan,
        "gini": float(_gini(s)),
    }
    # per-batch medians
    per_batch = {}
    for b in np.unique(batches):
        mb = mask & (batches == b)
        sb = sigma[mb]
        sb = sb[np.isfinite(sb)]
        per_batch[str(b)] = float(np.median(sb)) if sb.size else np.nan
    out["per_batch_median"] = per_batch
    return out

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    # Common config
    kdensity = 22
    k_total = 50
    delta = 0.12

    batches = np.asarray(adata.obs['batch'].astype('category').values)

    # 1) Ridge pipeline (GraphFWPCA+BRBG+DAQB) at δ=0.12
    ad_ridge = adata.copy()
    # Use ridge alias but enforce delta if configurable; else use default and annotate
    try:
        ad_ridge = ridge_alias.eliminate_batch_effect_fn(ad_ridge)
        D_ridge = ad_ridge.obsp.get('distances', None)
    except Exception as e:
        D_ridge = None
        print(f"[ridge] error: {e}")

    # 2) FWPCA-only at δ=0.12 (explicit)
    ad_fwpca = adata.copy()
    ad_fwpca = run_fwpca_only(
        ad_fwpca,
        alpha_g=0.50,
        kdensity=kdensity,
        k_total=k_total,
        delta=delta,
        metric='cosine',
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0,
        pbve_temper=None
    )
    D_fwpca = ad_fwpca.obsp.get('distances', None)

    results = {}
    if D_ridge is not None:
        sig_r = _kd_stat_from_distances(D_ridge, kdensity)
        results["ridge_d012"] = _summaries(sig_r, batches, "ridge_d012")
    else:
        results["ridge_d012"] = {"label": "ridge_d012", "error": "no_distances"}

    if D_fwpca is not None:
        sig_f = _kd_stat_from_distances(D_fwpca, kdensity)
        results["fwpca_d012"] = _summaries(sig_f, batches, "fwpca_d012")
    else:
        results["fwpca_d012"] = {"label": "fwpca_d012", "error": "no_distances"}

    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return "σ_kd diagnostics completed"
